phaseACommit.message: fix: harden quick bridge reliability and yumu dedup handling

layers: Wuxin callLocalBot opens per-call WS with X-Self-ID and posts synthetic group event
Shiro WebSocketServerHandler.handleTextMessage parses JSON and resolves the session Bot by X-Self-ID
Shiro group-event-filter dedup (QB-05) may drop silently
Shiro group-self-bot-event-filter (sender.user_id in robots.keys) may drop silently
EventUtils.setInterceptor passes (Yumu has no custom interceptor)

OneBotListener: stale-gate -> YumuGroupConfig.isGroupDisabled -> messageID build -> idempotentService.executeIdempotent(messageID, 30s, 2s concurrent wait) -> QQMessageCacheProvider.putMessage -> PermissionImplement.onMessage
PermissionImplement.onMessage line 80: AsyncMessageUtil.put(event) runs BEFORE any command filtering
filterMessage -> serviceMap loop -> isBlock permission checks -> service.handleMessage
dispatchChain.waiterCheckOrder: waiter notification precedes command filtering, permission checks and command dispatch
dispatchChain.waiterConsumer: com.now.nowbot.util.AsyncMessageUtil (object singleton inside the Yumu JVM)

waiterPredicate.scope: process-global: one LockManager singleton holds locks/futures/checks/timeouts maps for the whole Yumu JVM, keyed only by group/sender strings
waiterPredicate.consumption: peek-style: put() completes matching futures but never stops the event from continuing into the normal command dispatcher
waiterPredicate.consumeSemantics: consume-once per key (completeFuture guards !future.isDone); broadcast to every DISTINCT matching key
waiterPredicate.sameKeyRegistration: registerFuture replaces any previous future for the same key; the older AsyncLock is orphaned and never receives the event
waiterPredicate.getOrCreateFuture: returns an existing future for the key (completed or not) instead of creating a new one
waiterPredicate.expiration: AsyncLock.await(timeout) / doubleCheck future.get(timeout) -> null -> onOverTime; doubleCheck cleans its key in finally; getLock only cleans on unlock() via cleanupIfExpired
waiterPredicate.cancellationReplacement: no explicit cancellation API; keys are removed by cleanup (doubleCheck finally) or cleanupIfExpired (unlock of expired lock)
waiterPredicate.multipleMatchingWaiters: every distinct matching key receives the same event (broadcast); same-key waiters share one future and cannot both be completed
waiterPredicate.callbackThrow: doubleCheck onSuccess/onWrong exceptions propagate to the waiting thread (verified against bytecode) and are NOT caught by doubleCheck

identityOverlap.forward: A real user's pending Yumu waiter keyed group:<realGid>:<realUid> IS completed by a Wuxin synthetic event carrying the same group_id + sender.user_id. QuickRouter bridges use virtual group 770099, so overlap needs waiter traffic there; executor/lazybot->yumu recent fallback bridges with context.groupId (real group), where real prompts live.
identityOverlap.reverse: Wuxin bridge calls never register Yumu waiters for the six currently bridged commands (recent/bp/bs/pm/etx/rating service files contain zero AsyncMessageUtil calls; verifier asserts this). Reverse consumption is IMPOSSIBLE today and SOURCE_POSSIBLE only if interactive Yumu commands are bridged later.
identityOverlap.selfId: the Yumu event wrapper never exposes raw self_id to waiters, and waiter keys ignore it; self_id cannot isolate waiter semantics
identityOverlap.eventTime: ignored by waiter keys; cannot isolate
identityOverlap.messageContent: ignored by waiter keys; command-like, plain and empty text all consume (bytecode-probe confirmed)
identityOverlap.messageId: used by OneBotListener idempotency (separate 30s key [group|sender]subType(messageId)), not by waiters
identityOverlap.nonMessageEvents: reply/notice events have no @GroupMessageHandler and never reach PermissionImplement.onMessage, so they cannot hit group waiters through this dispatch path

collisionMatrix.condition: a waiter with key group:<gid>:<uid> (or sender:<uid>) exists
sender-scoped lock (sender:<uid>) would still match across groups

collisionMatrix.commandLikeText: SOURCE_CONFIRMED no match for group:<gid>:<uid>; SOURCE_CONFIRMED match for sender:<uid> locks

doesItExplain60sSilentTimeout.currentBridgedCommands: NO. put() is peek-style and never suppresses dispatch, so waiter consumption alone cannot make a current bridge call silent. The six bridged commands do not register waiters.
doesItExplain60sSilentTimeout.hypotheticalFutureBridgedCommands: YES mechanism exists: a service such as BestHistoryRecoverService calls getLock(event,30s).await() inside handleMessage; if such a command were ever bridged, the synthetic event would send a prompt frame then block waiting for a follow-up, and Wuxin would see open-but-silent until its own 60s timeout.
doesItExplain60sSilentTimeout.known60sCauses: dedup filter (QB-05, fixed), group config, pending prompt/lock swallow, upstream slowness, ACK failures
